changelog: New voice command "read last paragraph" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ অনুচ্ছেদ পড়ে শোনাও" in Bengali) and only the last paragraph before the cursor is read aloud, so you can check a long message one paragraph at a time instead of hearing the whole thing from the start. It is the scoped twin of v15.4's "read last sentence". The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 56 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
